description: This file defines an interface for internal memory storage grains used in the Orleans framework. It specifies asynchronous methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state data in memory.

classes.name: IMemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: Interface for internal memory storage grain used by Orleans in-memory storage provider, extending the generic IGrainWithIntegerKey interface it defines asynchronous methods for grain state management.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the grain's state data from memory storage based on a store key.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to update the grain's state data into memory storage with a new state and return an eTag.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to delete the grain's state data from memory storage based on a store key and an eTag.
